desc: A sanctum, dim and close. A flute, some oil and a torch lie here. A stone altar and a clay wall stand here. Ways out: an arch south and a stair down (closed).

features.name: stair down
features.note: "A stair of clay, leading down, closed." "The stair will not move."

features.name: clay wall
features.note: 584 signs over 37 pages. Old style; page 1 intact.

name: Temple sanctum
statusNote: Looked until nothing new; altar and wall (all 584 signs) transcribed. Come back for the closed clay stair, and for the oil and flute (pack full).
